הָאוּרִים is a definite common masculine plural (H224), not a proper name; urim leaves the lemma untranslated.
הַתֻּמִּים is a definite common masculine plural (H8550), not a proper name; tumim leaves the lemma untranslated.

notes: Person, number, Jehová, Aarón, and the נשא / היה clauses match the tokens.
